implemented mapper variants: swap_remove, fisher_yates, rejection

selection/survivor replication without independent OOS evidence
evidence.prior_attempt_failure: B201-B206 were queued but all failed as unknown engines before target-data validation.

decision.justification: This class is non-duplicative: it tests whether observable pre-draw state covariates carry chronological OOS information, rather than fitting another fixed RNG seed/family.
execution_gate: Use only variables available before each draw; no post-draw leakage.
Pre-register a small fixed feature set before scoring.
Day 1 training/selection only; days 2 and 3 independent OOS.
Correct for all tested features/models; require stable direction on both OOS days.
If no pre-draw covariate source is available, record this family as untestable rather than substitute draw-derived proxies.

privacy: No raw target draws, fingerprints, candidate ranking details, or wagering rationale included.
